title: decode-GEMV weight storage dtype (fp32/fp16/int8/int4+DEQ): null even bandwidth-bound

rewrite.to: fp16 / int8 / int4 + DEQUANTIZE twins (268 / 134 / 67 MB)
rewrite.equivalence_evidence: host corr vs fp32: fp16 1.000000, int8 0.999990, int4 0.996698 (executability proof; accuracy incidental to the speed claim)

scope: T=1 weight-streaming regime, 0.27 GF vs 537 MB - the opposite regime from the exp-1 null. Weight-only DEQ quantization buys zero CompiledModel decode latency anywhere; quantize for file size. int4+DEQ does compile and run on the NPU
notes: consistent with QNN materializing weights to one internal representation at compile (inference - the measured fact is the 0.6% equality)
